ui/skills/skill_slot.png.notes: 32x32 skill slot, same footprint as ui/portrait/btn32_*. Icon area 24x24 inside (4..27).

ui/skills/skill_slot_active.png.notes: 32x32 skill slot, same footprint as ui/portrait/btn32_*. Icon area 24x24 inside (4..27).

ui/skills/skill_slot_locked.png.notes: 32x32 skill slot, same footprint as ui/portrait/btn32_*. Icon area 24x24 inside (4..27).

ui/skills/skill_slot_passive.png.notes: PASSIVE slot: octagon with gold rim (reads differently from the square active slot). Not pressable, so there is no active/pressed state; dim with _locked while unlearned.

ui/skills/skill_slot_passive_locked.png.notes: PASSIVE slot: octagon with gold rim (reads differently from the square active slot). Not pressable, so there is no active/pressed state; dim with _locked while unlearned.

ui/skills/skill_cooldown_mask.png.notes: 50% checker dither; crop from the top by remaining-cooldown fraction and draw over the icon (binary alpha keeps the pixel look).

ui/skills/skill_sheet.png.notes: 8 columns (class) x 5 rows (skill 1..5). Active skills in skill_slot.png, passives in skill_slot_passive.png with a P tag. QA/reference sheet, not a runtime asset.

ui/portrait/action_bar_v2.png.notes: v6 per-character action bar (replaces ui/portrait/action_bar.png). Slot top-lefts in bar-local px: attack/cover default abilities (32x32), gold divider at x71, 5 class skills (32x32, step 33), Item/Run mini buttons (20x20) stacked at the right, 16x7 MP cost badges centred under each active skill (y38).

ui/portrait/ability_attack.png.notes: default ability "attack" in the skill-slot style (always available for every class).

ui/portrait/ability_attack_active.png.notes: selected state. default ability "attack" in the skill-slot style (always available for every class).

ui/portrait/ability_cover.png.notes: default ability "cover" in the skill-slot style (always available for every class).

ui/portrait/ability_cover_active.png.notes: selected state. default ability "cover" in the skill-slot style (always available for every class).

ui/portrait/digits_3x5.png.notes: tiny white digits 0-9 (3x5 glyph + 1px advance) for cost badges / cooldown counters. Tint by modulate if needed.

ui/portrait/cost_badge.png.notes: MP cost badge (blue pill + drop). Draw digits_3x5 at digit_origin (x 6 for 2 digits). Centre under each ACTIVE skill slot (slot x + 8, bar y 38). Passives get no badge.

ui/portrait/cost_badge_0_9.png.notes: pre-rendered cost badges for MP 0..9 (frame i = cost i).

ui/portrait/name_tab.png.notes: active-character nameplate tab: draw at bar top-left (x 4, bar_y - 10); class/hero name in the pixel font at text_origin (max ~13 chars). Gold = same highlight as hp_mp_card_compact_active.

ui/portrait/passive_dim_mask.png.notes: 25% ink dither drawn over a PASSIVE icon so it reads as non-pressable (binary alpha).

ui/portrait/lock_icon.png.notes: locked-skill padlock, draw at slot [11,11] over a dimmed icon in skill_slot_locked.

ui/portrait/seat_bars_frame.png.notes: v7 seat-mounted HP/MP bars: #120c18 outline frame with dark empty tracks (HP #3e1016, MP #161c40). Anchor = top-centre; place at (seat_x, seat_feet_y - 11) so it overlaps the chair seat front + lower rails. Fill with seat_bar_hp/mp (crop by %) or stretch the 1px tiles.

ui/portrait/seat_bars_frame_active.png.notes: ACTIVE seat variant: gold inner ring + dark outer outline (1px larger each side). Same anchor point as the normal frame (top-centre of the inner frame at [23,1]).

ui/portrait/seat_bar_hp.png.notes: HP fill (#ec5a44, #c02c2c bottom shade). Crop width = round(42 * hp%).

ui/portrait/seat_bar_mp.png.notes: MP fill (#4c9ce8 over #3466cc). Crop width = round(42 * mp%).

ui/portrait/seat_bar_hp_tile.png.notes: 1px HP fill column; stretch horizontally (nearest) instead of cropping the full strip.

ui/portrait/seat_bar_hp_lowflash.png.notes: low-HP (<25%) flash: frame 0 normal red, frame 1 cream/amber. Crop both frames to the same fill width.

ui/portrait/digits_3x5_outlined.png.notes: HP-number digits: cream 3x5 glyph (sand bottom row) with a 1px #120c18 outline (diagonals included) so it reads on any robe incl. white. Draw successive digits 4px apart (outline columns overlap).

ui/portrait/skill_card_panel.png.notes: notebook-page 9-slice for the skill card: dark outline, parchment, spiral holes along the top edge, red margin line on the left, faint ruled lines. TILE (not stretch) the edges/centre so holes and ruling keep an 8px rhythm; pick widths/heights = 48 + 8k for a seamless look.

ui/portrait/skill_card_tail.png.notes: pointer: tip (anchor) aims at the tapped slot centre; place so rows 0-1 cover the card bottom edge (tail y = card_bottom - 2).

ui/portrait/skill_card_strip_ready.png.notes: prompt strip: 3-slice (caps 5px, tile the middle). Text centred at y 5 in the pack 3x5 font. 2-frame pulse: swap frame + text colour gold/cream at 3 fps.

ui/portrait/skill_card_strip_passive.png.notes: prompt strip: 3-slice (caps 5px, tile the middle). Text centred at y 5 in the pack 3x5 font.

ui/portrait/skill_card_strip_nomp.png.notes: prompt strip: 3-slice (caps 5px, tile the middle). Text centred at y 5 in the pack 3x5 font.

ui/portrait/skill_card_strip_cooldown.pn.notes: prompt strip: 3-slice (caps 5px, tile the middle). Text centred at y 5 in the pack 3x5 font.

ui/portrait/skill_slot_armed.png.notes: ARMED state (skill card open, next tap casts): 2px pulsing gold/cream glow ring drawn around the 32px slot (outside the frame). Distinct from skill_slot_active (selected).

ui/portrait/bar_dim_mask.png.notes: 50% dither drawn over every OTHER bar slot while a skill card is open (optional focus dim).

ui/portrait/skill_card_icon_frame.png.notes: holds the 20x20 skill icon at 2x (nearest) at [2,2].

ui/portrait/skill_card_icon_frame_passiv.notes: holds the 20x20 skill icon at 2x (nearest) at [2,2]. Octagon = passive.

ui/portrait/skill_tag_active.png.notes: ACTIVE tag pill (word baked in the pack 3x5 font), top-right of the card.

ui/portrait/skill_tag_passive.png.notes: PASSIVE tag pill (word baked in the pack 3x5 font), top-right of the card.

ui/portrait/target_enemy.png.notes: tiny skill-card info icon (target type); text starts 2px to its right.

ui/portrait/target_all_enemies.png.notes: tiny skill-card info icon (target type); text starts 2px to its right.

ui/portrait/target_ally.png.notes: tiny skill-card info icon (target type); text starts 2px to its right.

ui/portrait/target_all_allies.png.notes: tiny skill-card info icon (target type); text starts 2px to its right.

ui/portrait/target_self.png.notes: tiny skill-card info icon (target type); text starts 2px to its right.

ui/portrait/icon_cooldown.png.notes: tiny skill-card info icon (cooldown turns); text starts 2px to its right.

ui/dmg_font_mp_letters.png.notes: glyph order 'MP', same style/advance (6px) as ui/dmg_font_mp.png so code can draw '+5 MP' (digits from dmg_font_mp).

fx/fx_slash.png.notes: diagonal arc sweep; centre anchor on the target body (e.g. monster centre). Flip h for the other direction. Frame 2 = impact (spawn damage number / hit anim).
fx/fx_slash.png.style: no black outline (glow FX): bright core -> darker coloured rim, binary alpha, fades via ordered dither

travel.notes: projectile faces +x; tween the sprite from caster to target, rotate/flip toward the target

burst.notes: play at the target centre; frame 4 = impact

fx/fx_fireball.png.notes: one strip: travel loop (0-2) + burst (3-7). Same 48x48 cell for both, anchor = ball/burst centre.
fx/fx_fireball.png.style: no black outline (glow FX): bright core -> darker coloured rim, binary alpha, fades via ordered dither

fx/fx_heal_sparkle.png.notes: anchor on the seat/monster feet (bottom-centre). Loop 1-2x. Heal colour lime #b4dc62; pair with ui/dmg_font_heal.
fx/fx_heal_sparkle.png.style: no black outline (glow FX): bright core -> darker coloured rim, binary alpha, fades via ordered dither

fx/fx_buff_aura.png.notes: gold rising aura + chevrons; anchor on feet. Draw the whole strip BEHIND the seat for a softer look, or in front (ring front arc overlaps feet).
fx/fx_buff_aura.png.style: no black outline (glow FX): bright core -> darker coloured rim, binary alpha, fades via ordered dither

fx/fx_poison_cloud.png.notes: toxic purple puffs with acid-green bubbles (purple keeps it readable over the green meadow); anchor ~ target waist/centre. Frames 2-3 can loop while a DoT ticks.
fx/fx_poison_cloud.png.style: no black outline (glow FX): bright core -> darker coloured rim, binary alpha, fades via ordered dither

fx/fx_shield.png.notes: force bubble around a 48x70 seat/monster; anchor on feet. Play 0-1 once then loop 2-4 while the shield lasts; pixel-hex fill keeps the target visible (binary alpha).
fx/fx_shield.png.style: no black outline (glow FX): bright core -> darker coloured rim, binary alpha, fades via ordered dither

fx/fx_lightning.png.notes: strike from above; anchor = impact point at the target feet (bottom-centre). Frame 2 = impact flash. Hold frame 1-2 alternation for longer zaps.
fx/fx_lightning.png.style: no black outline (glow FX): bright core -> darker coloured rim, binary alpha, fades via ordered dither

fx/taunt_badge.png.notes: overhead taunt/aggro badge (red "!" shout). Place the anchor ~2px above the top of the seat/monster sprite (e.g. seat top y = feet-78+hat). 1px bob. Has a dark outline like UI icons.
fx/taunt_badge.png.style: no black outline (glow FX): bright core -> darker coloured rim, binary alpha, fades via ordered dither

fx/taunt_aura.png.notes: optional subtle red ground ring for a taunting seat/monster; centre it on the feet row (seat anchor) and draw BEHIND the sprite.
fx/taunt_aura.png.style: no black outline (glow FX): bright core -> darker coloured rim, binary alpha, fades via ordered dither

fx/mana_tick.png.notes: subtle MP-regen tick in the MP colour #4c9ce8: blue sparkles rising. Anchor at the seat feet/centre or on the MP bar of the card; play once per regen tick. Pair with fx/mp_plus.png.
fx/mana_tick.png.style: no black outline (glow FX): bright core -> darker coloured rim, binary alpha, fades via ordered dither

fx/mp_plus.png.notes: '+MP' float in MP colours: rises 1px/frame, last frame dithered out. For numbers use dmg_font_mp + dmg_font_mp_letters instead.
fx/mp_plus.png.style: no black outline (glow FX): bright core -> darker coloured rim, binary alpha, fades via ordered dither
